name: Ebihara Honoka
source:
Hobbies: Walking around while drinking and eating
Skills: Being a glutton
Likes: Cats
Dislikes: Cheap taverns
Favorite food: Noodles (Especially after a drink or couple), alcholic drinks in general
Hated food: Oysters

[url=/c17268]Shotarou's[/url] homeroom teacher who teaches world history. She has a rival-like relationship with him. Honoka takes her work seriously, but other manners regarding to her life very lazily. She has a very fierce mouth and curses often, but is just a misunderstood maiden at heart. Honoka likes cats so much that she fights like one whenever she gets into fights with the students.
